catalysts.headline: FDA's PDUFA target action date for the sNDA expanding IGALMI's label to at-home/outpatient use (BXCL501, Phase 3 SERENITY At-Home) falls on 2026-11-14. As of this session's searches, no approval/decision outcome has been reported.
catalysts.impact: Directly relevant to Teva's contingent development milestone (up to $67.5M) tied to FDA approval of IGALMI for at-home use, part of the already-on-file closed Teva asset-sale terms (closed 2026-10-26).

catalysts.headline: Teva asset-sale transaction reported closed (single-source report); Teva acquired rights to IGALMI and BXCL501, BioXcel retained BXCL701/BXCL702
Teva completed its acquisition of substantially all of BioXcel's neuroscience assets (IGALMI, BXCL501) out of Chapter 11; BioXcel retained BXCL701/BXCL702, which were excluded from the sale
catalysts.impact: $57.5M cash paid at closing (crediting an earlier $5.75M deposit) plus assumed liabilities; up to $67.5M development milestone tied to FDA approval of IGALMI for at-home use, up to $20M in commercial milestones if that approval isn't obtained by 2027-02-28; proceeds used to repay DIP financing

catalysts.headline: Delaware bankruptcy court entered Sale Order approving sale of substantially all BioXcel assets to Teva after auction was cancelled for lack of other qualifying bids

Delaware bankruptcy court approved BioXcel's asset sale to Teva (reported deal value up to ~$125M total); judge also allowed the combined Chapter 11 plan and disclosure statement to go to a creditor vote
catalysts.impact: Resolves the previously-unresolved auction: no qualified competing bids emerged, so Teva (the stalking-horse bidder) was designated the successful bidder by default rather than via a live auction; sale closing was reportedly targeted for ~2026-10-26, which could not be confirmed as having occurred as of this session (today is 2026-10-22)
catalysts.source: Law360 (Emily Lever, Oct 21 2026, 'BioXcel Gets Nod For $125M Bankruptcy Sale To Teva'); corroborated by weekly bankruptcy-docket trackers (Bondoro, bankruptcyobserver.com)

catalysts.headline: U.S. Trustee objected to the combined Chapter 11 plan and disclosure statement, specifically over third-party release provisions
catalysts.impact: Potential friction in plan confirmation process
catalysts.source: docket-tracker summary (secondary source; original objection filing not independently viewed)

catalysts.headline: Objections to the Teva sale were filed with the bankruptcy court
catalysts.impact: Did not ultimately block court approval on Oct 21

catalysts.headline: BioXcel filed a notice canceling the planned Oct 14 auction and designating a successful bidder (Dkt. 232) after no competing bids were submitted
catalysts.impact: Confirms the Oct 14 auction described in the prior dashboard snapshot did not actually occur as a live auction

catalysts.headline: Per the bidding-procedures motion, competing bids for BioXcel's assets were due Oct 9, 2026, with an auction proposed for Oct 14, 2026, ahead of an Oct 30, 2026 outside date for the sale; auction outcome (whether Teva's stalking-horse bid prevailed) could not be confirmed

BioXcel Therapeutics files for Chapter 11 and signs an asset purchase agreement with Teva as stalking-horse bidder for IGALMI (dexmedetomidine sublingual film, BXCL501) — $57.5M cash upfront, up to $67.5M in development milestones tied to the pending sNDA, up to $20M in commercial milestones, plus assumed liabilities
catalysts.impact: Major restructuring event; sale covers IGALMI/BXCL501 assets, not the whole company

catalysts.headline: Common stock trading suspended on Nasdaq at market open; migrated to OTC Pink Limited Market under new ticker BTAIQ; company said it does not intend to appeal

BioXcel filed for Chapter 11 (Case No. 26-11360 (TMH), Delaware); Teva named stalking-horse bidder ($57.5M upfront cash plus up to $67.5M in contingent/milestone payments); Samir Saleem named Chief Restructuring Officer

BioXcel Therapeutics and two subsidiaries filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions in U.S. Bankruptcy Court, District of Delaware (Case No. 26-11360); Teva Pharmaceuticals named stalking-horse bidder for IGALMI/dexmedetomidine assets ($57.5M upfront + up to $67.5M milestones); Oaktree Capital and Qatar Investment Authority providing $19M new-money DIP financing (total DIP facility $77M)
BioXcel Therapeutics and two subsidiaries filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions; entered an asset sale agreement with Teva Pharmaceuticals as stalking-horse bidder in a court-supervised sale process
catalysts.impact: stock collapsed from ~$0.72 to ~$0.18 over the following sessions

catalysts.headline: FDA accepted sNDA for IGALMI use in the at-home/outpatient setting, set PDUFA target action date of November 14, 2026
FDA accepted BioXcel's sNDA to expand IGALMI label to at-home/outpatient use (Phase 3 SERENITY At-Home trial); PDUFA target action date Nov 14, 2026

conflicts: Price for 2026-09-04: marketchameleon.com reports $0.07 vs massive.com reports $0.0422 (-42.90%) for the same date.

Total Teva deal value reported inconsistently across outlets: ~$125M (biospace.com, americanpharmaceuticalreview.com: $57.5M upfront + up to $67.5M contingent) vs ~$145M (hartfordbusiness.com). Not reconciled.

Closing date of the Teva transaction: only a single source (dealroom.co) reports a 2026-10-26 close; no independent corroboration found despite the court's Sale Order being entered 2026-10-21 per the company's 8-K.
